khm.text: Tyvar Kell, an elf prince, first appears in Kaldheim by turning all six Torga trolls to stone with a touch, and he tells Kaya that ever since Tibalt visited his brother Harald, the elves have been preparing for war.

He opens a doorway into the Cosmos, which leads Kaya to realize he is a planeswalker, and he guides her into the demons' realm of Immersturm, where he grows a stone bridge across the magma and shapes two iron axes from a demon's hammer for the unarmed Kaya.
Kaya and Tyvar fail to stop Tibalt from creating a Doomskar, and thousands of demons led by Varragoth attack another realm.

Later Tyvar grows suspicious of Harald's change of heart, explains Tibalt's machinations in Bretagard, and helps Harald decide to fight the invaders and deliver the Sword to Halvar; Kaya ends the Doomskar by cutting Varragoth's throat with one of Tyvar's axes, and Tyvar resolves to walk the Multiverse.

one.text: In Phyrexia: All Will Be One, Tyvar Kell is found as a statue of an elf containing Zendikari hedron stone, suspended in cables on New Phyrexia, and Kaito and Nahiri cut him free.
He reverts to flesh, introduces himself as Prince of Kaldheim, and answers Jace's call by joining the strike team sent to deactivate Realmbreaker.
Tyvar spreads Glimmervoid metal over the group so they can pass through the gateway to the Seedcore, and he later carries Jace into the tree's root cavity when Jace collapses.
He and Elspeth stay behind to battle Ajani and Tibalt, and Tyvar kills Tibalt with Tibalt's own tail barbs, but Elesh Norn then activates Realmbreaker and begins the invasion.

dsk.text: In Duskmourn: House of Horror, Tyvar Kell is fighting a lone wolf on Kaldheim with a stone-fisted punch when Kaito recruits him for a rescue, and Tyvar eagerly agrees.
He vouches for Niko Aris as the defensive fighter Kaito needs, and the team enters the door on Ravnica to Duskmourn.
Inside the House, Tyvar runs toward a voice crying for help and is separated from the others with Zimone, and a horror disembowels him, discharging his fateshifter.
He turns his body to plaster to match the creature's flesh, but he and Zimone nearly lose themselves in the House's camouflage.
Tyvar and Zimone meet Marina Vendrell and find her diary, then rescue Nashi, Niko and the Wanderer from the cult and escape through an Omenpath opened by Kaito.
